newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office Products completes $195 mln buy.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office Products completes $195 mln buy.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said Tuesday it had completed the acquisition of nine new hub companies with annualized revenues totalling about $340 million.
The acquisitions were made in exchange for about $195 million in U.S. Office Products stock.
All the acquisitions qualified as poolings of interest and will be accretive to earnings, U.S. Office Products said.

"Our acquisition program is focused on acquiring the most profitable companies in an environment where our competitors have been sidetracked by operating issues," Chairman Jonathan Ledecky said. "We bought companies averaging more than our long-term operating margin goal of eight percent for approximately six times adjusted annualized operating income."
He said this would lead to significant growth in sales and earnings in the future.
The acquired companies are located in Ontario, New York, Missouri, Texas, Washington, New Jersey, Memphis and Virginia, the company said.
